# clavis secrets get

<p class="cli-lead">Print one secret value</p>

<div class="cli-usage">

```sh
clavis secrets get KEY [flags]
```

</div>

Print one value, for use in scripts. The read is audited.

## Examples

```sh
clavis secrets get DATABASE_URL
```

<p class="cli-example-title">In a script</p>

```sh
psql "$(clavis secrets get DATABASE_URL)"
```
